|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Captain Raymus Antilles (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-captainraymusantilles-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no image of the earlier text was found. Listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-captainraymusantille022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/captainraymusantilles.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/captainraymusantilles.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Warrior’s Courage”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 while piloting any Rebel capital starship). Deploys -1 aboard Tantive IV. While aboard Tantive IV, it is immune to Lateral Damage and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Raymus Antilles (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 1 December 2022<ref name="img-captainraymusantilleeb53af7">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/captainraymusantilles.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af72c4491442a863d743950ff8a472ed77b3 commit eb53af7] (1 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/captainraymusantilles.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Warrior’s Courage”.
